snippet: == Examples of Computable Numbers ==

label: Computable Real Sequence iff Limits of Computable Rational Sequences
snippet: Let $\sequence {x_m}$ be a sequence of real numbers. Then, $\sequence {x_m}$ is computable there exist: A computable rational sequence $\sequence {a_k}$ Total recursive functions $\phi, \psi : \N^2 \to \N$ such that: $\forall m, p \in \N: \forall n \ge \map \psi {m, p}: \size {a_{\map \phi {m, n}} - x_m} < \dfrac 1 {p + 1}$

label: Concentration of Lipschitz Functionals of Normal Vector
snippet: Let $X_1, \dots, X_n$ be continuous random variables with a standard normal distribution $\Gaussian 0 1$. Let $F: \R^n \to \R$ be L-Lipschitz. Then: $\map \Pr {\size {\map F X - \expect {\map F X} } > L u} \le \map \exp {-\dfrac {u^2} {2 C} }$ where: $\Pr$ denotes the probability function $\expect {\, \cdot \,}$ denotes expectation.

label: Concentric Circles do not Intersect
snippet: If two circles are concentric, they share no points on their circumferences. Alternatively, this can be worded: If two concentric circles share one point on their circumferences, then they share them all (that is, they are the same circle).

label: Condition for 3 Points in Plane to be Collinear
snippet: Let $A = \tuple {x_1, y_1}, B = \tuple {x_2, y_2}, C = \tuple {x_3, y_3}$ be points in the Cartesian plane. Then: $A$, $B$ and $C$ are collinear the determinant: $\begin {vmatrix} x_1 & y_1 & 1 \\ x_2 & y_2 & 1 \\ x_3 & y_3 & 1 \\ \end {vmatrix}$ equals zero.

label: Condition for 3 over n producing 3 Egyptian Fractions using Greedy Algorithm when 2 Sufficient
snippet: Consider proper fractions of the form $\dfrac 3 n$ expressed in canonical form. Let Fibonacci's Greedy Algorithm be used to generate a sequence $S$ of Egyptian fractions for $\dfrac 3 n$. Then $S$ consists of $3$ terms, where $2$ would be sufficient the following conditions hold: $n \equiv 1 \pmod 6$ $\exists d: d \divides n$ and $d \equiv 2 \pmod 3$

label: Condition for 4 Points to be Coplanar
snippet: Let: {{eqn | l = p_1 | r = \tuple {x_1, y_1, z_1} }} {{eqn | l = p_2 | r = \tuple {x_2, y_2, z_2} }} {{eqn | l = p_3 | r = \tuple {x_3, y_3, z_3} }} {{eqn | l = p_4 | r = \tuple {x_4, y_4, z_4} }} be distinct points in Cartesian $3$-space. Then $p_1$, $p_2$, $p_3$ and $p_4$ are coplanar : $\begin {vmatrix} x_1 & y_1 & z_1 & 1 \\ x_2 & y_2 & z_2 & 1 \\ x_3 & y_3 & z_3 & 1 \\ x_4 & y_4 & z_4 & 1 \end {vmatrix} = 0$ where the construct is evaluated as a determinant.

label: Condition for Alexandroff Extension to be T1
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a non-empty topological space. Let $p$ be a new element not in $S$. Let $S^* := S \cup \set p$. Let $T^* = \struct {S^*, \tau^*}$ be the Alexandroff extension on $S$. Then $T^*$ is a $T_1$ space $T$ is a $T_1$ space.

label: Condition for Alexandroff Extension to be T2
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a non-empty topological space. Let $p$ be a new element not in $S$. Let $S^* := S \cup \set p$. Let $T^* =\struct {S^*, \tau^*}$ be the Alexandroff extension on $S$. Then $T^*$ is a $T_2$ (Hausdorff) space $T$ is a locally compact Hausdorff space.

label: Condition for Algebra Loop to be Abelian Group
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \odot}$ be an algebra loop. Let $\struct {S \times S, \otimes}$ denote the external direct product of $\struct {S, \odot}$ with itself: $\forall \tuple {x_1, y_1}, \tuple {x_2, y_2} \in S \times S: \tuple {x_1, y_1} \otimes \tuple {x_2, y_2} = \tuple {x_1 \odot x_2, y_1 \odot y_2}$ Let $f$ and $g$ be mappings from $\struct {S \times S, \otimes}$ to $\struct {S, \odot}$. Let $f \odot g$ denote the pointwise operation on $S^{S \times S}$ induced by $\odot$.

label: Condition for Algebraic Structure to be Self-Distributive Quasigroup
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \odot}$ be an algebraic structure. Then: $\struct {S, \odot}$ is a self-distributive quasigroup for every $a \in S$, the left and right regular representations $\lambda_a$ and $\rho_a$ on $S$ are automorphisms of $\struct {S, \odot}$.

label: Condition for Bipartite Graph to be Hamiltonian
snippet: Let $G = \struct {A \mid B, E}$ be a bipartite graph. Let $G$ be Hamiltonian. Then $\card A = \card B$. That is, there is the same number of vertices in $A$ as there are in $B$.

label: Condition for Cartesian Product Equivalent to Associated Cardinal Number
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be nonempty sets. Let $\card S$ denote the cardinal number of $S$. Then: $S \times T \sim \card {S \times T} \iff S \sim \card S \land T \sim \card T$ where $S \times T$ denotes the cartesian product of $S$ and $T$.

label: Condition for Circles to be Orthogonal
snippet: Let $\CC_1$ and $\CC_2$ be circles embedded in a Cartesian plane. Let $\CC_1$ and $\CC_2$ be described by Equation of Circle in Cartesian Plane as: Then $\CC_1$ and $\CC_2$ are orthogonal : $2 \alpha_1 \alpha_2 + 2 \beta_1 \beta_2 = c_1 + c_2$

label: Condition for Closed Extension Space to be T0 Space
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $T^*_p = \struct {S^*_p, \tau^*_p}$ be the closed extension space of $T$. Then $T^*_p$ is a $T_0$ space $T$ is.

label: Condition for Closed Extension Space to be T4 Space
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $T^*_p = \struct {S^*_p, \tau^*_p}$ be the closed extension space of $T$. Then: $T^*_p$ is a $T_4$ space $T$ is a $T_4$ space vacuously and $T^*_p$ in this case is also a $T_4$ space vacuously.

label: Condition for Closed Extension Space to be T5 Space
snippet: Let $T = \struct {S, \tau}$ be a topological space. Let $T^*_p = \struct {S^*_p, \tau^*_p}$ be the closed extension space of $T$. Then: $T^*_p$ is a $T_5$ space $T$ is a $T_5$ space vacuously and $T^*_p$ in this case is also a $T_5$ space vacuously.

label: Condition for Closure of Open Ball to be Closed Ball of Same Radius
snippet: Let $\struct {M, d}$ be a metric space. $(1) \quad$ for all $x \in X$ and $r > 0$ we have $\map \cl {\map {B_r} x} = \map { {B_r}^-} x$, where $\cl$ denotes closure $(2) \quad$ for each $\epsilon > 0$ and $x, y \in X$ with $x \ne y$, there exists $z \in X$ with $\map d {z, y} < \epsilon$ and $\map d {x, z} < \map d {x, y}$.

label: Condition for Cofinal Nonlimit Ordinals
snippet: Let $x$ and $y$ be nonlimit ordinals. Let $\operatorname{cof}$ denote the cofinal relation. Let $\le$ denote the subset relation. Furthermore, let $x$ and $y$ satisfy the condition: $0 < x \le y$ Then: $\map {\operatorname{cof}} { y,x }$

label: Condition for Collinearity of Points in Complex Plane
Condition for Commensurability of Roots of Quadratic Equation
snippet: Consider the quadratic equation: $(1): \quad a x - x^2 = \dfrac {b^2} 4$ Then $x$ and $a - x$ are commensurable $\sqrt{a^2 - b^2}$ and $a$ are commensurable.

label: Condition for Complete Bipartite Graph to be Edgeless
snippet: Let $G = \struct {A \mid B, E} =: K_{m, n}$ be the complete bipartite graph with $m$ vertices in $A$ and $n$ vertices in $B$. Then: $K_{m, n}$ is edgeless either $m = 0$ or $n = 0$.

label: Condition for Composite Mapping on Left
snippet: Let $A, B, C$ be sets. Suppose that $C$ is non-empty. Let $f: A \to B$ and $g: A \to C$ be mappings. Let $\RR: B \to C$ be a relation such that $g = \RR \circ f$ is the composite of $f$ and $\RR$. Then $\RR$ may be a mapping : $\forall x, y \in A: \map f x = \map f y \implies \map g x = \map g y$ That is: $\forall x, y \in A: \map f x = \map f y \implies \map g x = \map g y$ $\exists h: B \to C$ such that $h$ is a mapping and $h \circ f = g$

label: Condition for Composite Mapping on Right
snippet: Let $A, B, C$ be sets. Let $f: B \to A$ and $g: C \to A$ be mappings. Let $\RR: C \to B$ be a relation such that $g = f \circ \RR$ is the composite of $\RR$ and $f$. Then $\RR$ may be a mapping : $\Img g \subseteq \Img f$ That is: $\Img g \subseteq \Img f$ $\exists h: C \to B$ such that $h$ is a mapping and $f \circ h = g$

label: Condition for Composite Mapping to be Identity
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $f: S \to T$ and $g: T \to S$ be mappings such that: $g \circ f = I_S$ where $I_S$ is the identity mapping on $S$. Then $f$ is an injection and $g$ is a surjection.

label: Condition for Composition Series
snippet: Let $G$ be a finite group. Then: a normal series $\HH$ for $G$ is a composition series for $G$ every factor group of $\HH$ is a simple group.

label: Condition for Composition of Linear Real Functions to be Commutative
snippet: Let $a, b, c, d \in \R$ be real numbers. Let $\theta_{a, b}: \R \to \R$ be the real function defined as: $\forall x \in \R: \map {\theta_{a, b} } x = a x + b$ Let $\theta_{c, d} \circ \theta_{a, b}$ denote the composition of $\theta_{c, d}$ with $\theta_{a, b}$. Then: $\theta_{c, d} \circ \theta_{a, b} = \theta_{a, b} \circ \theta_{c, d}$ $b c + d = a d + b$

label: Condition for Concurrency of Three Straight Lines
snippet: Let $3$ straight lines $\LL_1$, $\LL_2$ and $\LL_3$ be embedded in a cartesian plane $\CC$, expressed using the general equations: Then $\LL_1$, $\LL_2$ and $\LL_3$ are concurrent : $\begin {vmatrix} l_1 & m_1 & n_1 \\ l_2 & m_2 & n_2 \\ l_3 & m_3 & n_3 \end {vmatrix} = 0$ where $\begin {vmatrix} \cdot \end {vmatrix}$ denotes a determinant.

label: Condition for Conditional Expectation to be Almost Surely Non-Negative
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ be an integrable random variable on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $\GG \subseteq \Sigma$ be a sub-$\sigma$-algebra of $\Sigma$. Let $\expect {X \mid \GG}$ be a version of the conditional expectation of $X$ given $\GG$. Then we have: $\expect {X \mid \GG} \ge 0$ almost everywhere $\expect {X \cdot \chi_A} \ge 0$ for each $A \in \GG$ where $\chi_A$ is the characteristic function of $A$.

label: Condition for Conic to be Central
snippet: Let $\CC$ be a conic section whose equation is given by: $a x^2 + 2 h x y + b y^2 + 2 g x + 2 f y + c = 0$ Then $\CC$ is a central conic $a b \ne h^2$.

label: Condition for Coordinate Axes to have Same Orientation
snippet: Let $\CC_1$ and $\CC_2$ be Cartesian coordinate systems of the same dimension. Let $\EE_1$ and $\EE_2$ denote an ordered basis of $\CC_1$ and $\CC_2$ respectively. Then: $\CC_1$ and $\CC_2$ have the same orientation the matrix representing $\EE_1$ in terms of $\EE_2$ (and $\EE_2$ in terms of $\EE_1$) has a (strictly) positive determinant .

label: Condition for Cosets of Subgroup of Monoid to be Partition
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a monoid whose identity element is $e$. Let $\struct {H, \circ}$ be a subgroup of $\struct {S, \circ}$. Let the identity element of $\struct {H, \circ}$ be $e$. Then: the set of left cosets of $\struct {H, \circ}$ in $\struct {S, \circ}$ form a partition of $S$ and: the set of right cosets of $\struct {H, \circ}$ in $\struct {S, \circ}$ form a partition of $S$.

label: Condition for Cross-Ratio to be Harmonic
snippet: Let $A$, $B$, $C$ and $D$ be points on a straight line. Let their cross-ratio $\set {A, B; C, D}$ be a harmonic ratio. Then: $\set {A, B; C, D} = \set {B, A; C, D}$

label: Condition for Curve to be Elliptic
snippet: Let $C$ be an elliptic curve embedded in the Cartesian plane expressed in standard form: $y^2 = x^3 + a x + b$ Then: $4 a^3 + 27 b^2 \ne 0$

label: Condition for Denesting of Square Root
snippet: Let $a, b \in \Q_{\ge 0}$. Suppose $\sqrt b \notin \Q$. Then: $\exists p, q \in \Q: \sqrt {a + \sqrt b} = \sqrt p + \sqrt q$ $\exists n \in \Q: a^2 - b = n^2$.

label: Condition for Differentiable Functional to have Extremum
snippet: Let $S$ be a set of mappings. Let $y, h \in S: \R \to \R$ be real functions. Let $J \sqbrk y: S \to \R$ be a differentiable functional. Then a necessary condition for the differentiable functional $J \sqbrk {y; h}$ to have an extremum for $y = \hat y$ is: $\bigvalueat {\delta J \sqbrk {y; h} } {y \mathop = \hat y} = 0$

label: Condition for Differential to be Exact
snippet: The expression: $\ds \sum_i P_i \rd x_i$ where $\set {P_i}$ are real-valued functions over $\set {x_1, x_2, \ldots}$ is an exact differential : $\forall i, j : \dfrac {\partial P_i} {\partial x_j} = \dfrac {\partial P_j} {\partial x_i}$

label: Condition for Divisibility of Powers of Prime
snippet: Let $p$ be a prime. Let $k, l \in \Z_{>0}$. Then: $p^k \divides p^l \iff k \le l$

label: Condition for Element of Quotient Group of Additive Group of Reals by Integers to be of Finite Order
snippet: Let $\struct {\R, +}$ be the additive group of real numbers. Let $\struct {\Z, +}$ be the additive group of integers. Let $\R / \Z$ denote the quotient group of $\struct {\R, +}$ by $\struct {\Z, +}$. Let $x + \Z$ denote the coset of $\Z$ by $x \in \R$. Then $x + \Z$ is of finite order $x$ is rational.

label: Condition for Equal Angles contained by Elevated Straight Lines from Plane Angles
Condition for Equilibrium using Force Polygon
snippet: Let $\SS$ be a system of forces $\SS$ act at a point. Let $\SS$ give rise to a force polygon $A_0 A_1 \ldots A_n A_0$. Then $\SS$ is in equilibrium $A_n$ and $A_0$ coincide.

label: Condition for Equivalence Relation for Max Operation on Natural Numbers to be Congruence
snippet: Let $\RR$ be an equivalence relation on the set of natural numbers $\N$. Let $\vee$ denote the max operation on $\N$: $\forall a, b \in \N: a \vee b := \max \set {a, b}$ Then: $\RR$ is a congruence relation for $\vee$ on $\N$ every equivalence class under $\RR$ is an order-convex subset of $\N$.

label: Condition for Existence of Cardinal Sum
snippet: Let $\mathbf a$ and $\mathbf b$ be cardinals. Then: $\mathbf a \le \mathbf b \iff \exists \mathbf c: \mathbf a + \mathbf c = \mathbf b$ where $\mathbf c$ is also a cardinal.

label: Condition for Existence of Epimorphism from Quotient Structure to Epimorphic Image
snippet: Let $\struct {A, \odot}$ and $\struct {B, \otimes}$ be algebraic structures. Let $\RR$ be a congruence relation on $\struct {A, \odot}$. Let $f: \struct {A, \odot} \to \struct {B, \otimes}$ be an epimorphism. Let $\struct {A / \RR, \odot_\RR}$ denote the quotient structure defined by $\RR$. Let $q_\RR: A \to A / \RR$ denote the quotient mapping induced by $\RR$: $\forall x \in A: \map {q_\RR} x = \eqclass x \RR$ where $\eqclass x \RR$ denotes the equivalence class of $x$ under $\RR$.

label: Condition for Existence of Expectation of Real-Valued Measurable Function composed with Absolutely Continuous Random Variable
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ be an absolutely continuous random variable on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $P_X$ be the probability distribution of $X$. Let $\map \BB \R$ be the Borel $\sigma$-algebra of $\R$. Let $h : \R \to \R$ be a $\map \BB \R$-measurable function. Let $\lambda$ be the Lebesgue measure on $\struct {\R, \map \BB \R}$. Then $\map h X$ is integrable $h$ is $\lambda$-integrable function. In this case: $\ds \expect {\map h X} = \int_\R \map h x \rd \map {P_X} x$ where $\expect {\map h X}$ denotes the expectation of $\map h X$.

label: Condition for Existence of Third Number Proportional to Two Numbers
snippet: Let $a, b, c \in \Z$ be integers. Let $\tuple {a, b, c}$ be a geometric sequence. In order for this to be possible, both of these conditions must be true: $(1): \quad a$ and $b$ cannot be coprime $(2): \quad a \divides b^2$ where $\divides$ denotes divisibility.

label: Condition for Expectation of Non-Negative Random Variable to be Zero
snippet: Let $X$ be a random variable. Let: $\map \Pr {X \ge 0} = 1$ Then $\expect X = 0$ $\map \Pr {X = 0} = 1$.

label: Condition for Factoring of Quotient Mapping between Modulo Addition Groups
snippet: Let $m, n \in \Z_{>0}$ be strictly positive integers. Let $\struct {\Z, +}$ denote the additive group of integers. Let $\struct {\Z_m, +_m}$ and $\struct {\Z_n, +_n}$ denote the additive groups of integers modulo $m$ and $n$ respectively. Let $f: \Z \to \Z_n$ be the quotient epimorphism from $\struct {\Z, +}$ to $\struct {\Z_n, +_n}$. Let $q: \Z \to \Z_m$ be the quotient epimorphism from $\struct {\Z, +}$ to $\struct {\Z_m, +_m}$. Then: there exists a group homomorphism $\psi: \struct {\Z_m, +_m} \to \struct {\Z_n, +_n}$ $m \divides n$ where $\divides$ denotes divisibility.

label: Condition for Fixed Point to be Attracting
snippet: Let $x_{n + 1} = \map \phi {x_n}$ be a direct iteration for the purpose of finding a solution to the equation: $x = \map \phi x$ for some real function $\phi: \R \to \R$. Let $\alpha$ be such that $\alpha = \map \phi \alpha$. Let $\sequence {\map \phi {x_n} }$ converge to $\alpha$ for $\size {x_0 - \alpha}$ sufficiently small. That is, let $\alpha$ be an attracting fixed point of $\phi$. Then: $\size {\map {g'} \alpha} < 1$ where: $\size {\, \cdot \,}$ denotes the absolute value function $\map {g'} \alpha$ denotes the derivative of $\phi$ $x$.

label: Condition for Group Endomorphism to Commute with All Inner Automorphisms
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $\phi: G \to G$ be an endomorphism on $G$. Let $\phi$ be such that: $\forall a \in G: \kappa_a \circ \phi = \phi \circ \kappa_a$ where: $\kappa_a$ denotes the inner automorphism of $G$ given by $a$ $\circ$ denotes composition of mappings. Then: $H = \set {x \in G: \map \phi {\map \phi x} = \map \phi x}$ is a normal subgroup of $G$. Also, the quotient group $G / H$ is an abelian group.

label: Condition for Group to be Solvable
snippet: Let $G$ be a group. Let $G$ be such that: $G$ has a normal subgroup $H$ which is solvable the quotient group $G / H$ is cyclic. Then $G$ is a solvable group.

label: Condition for Ideal to be Total Ring
snippet: Let $\struct {A, +, \circ}$ be a commutative ring with unity. Let $I$ be an ideal of $A$ such that the quotient ring $A / I$ is a field. Let $J$ be an ideal of $A$ such that $I \subsetneq J$. Then: $A = J$

label: Condition for Incommensurability of Roots of Quadratic Equation
snippet: Consider the quadratic equation: $(1): \quad a x - x^2 = \dfrac {b^2} 4$ Then $x$ and $a - x$ are incommensurable $\sqrt {a^2 - b^2}$ and $a$ are incommensurable.

label: Condition for Independence from Product of Expectations
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ and $Y$ be discrete random variables on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Let $\expect X$ denote the expectation of $X$. Then $X$ and $Y$ are independent : $\expect {\map g x \map h y} = \expect {\map g x} \expect {\map h y}$ for all functions $g, h: \R \to \R$ for which the latter two expectations exist.

label: Condition for Independence of Discrete Random Variables
snippet: Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a probability space. Let $X$ and $Y$ be discrete random variables on $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$. Then $X$ and $Y$ are independent there exist functions $f, g: \R \to \R$ such that the joint mass function of $X$ and $Y$ satisfies: $\forall x, y \in \R: \map {p_{X, Y} } {x, y} = \map f x \map g y$

label: Condition for Infimum of Subset to equal Infimum of Set
snippet: == Lemma == Let $S$ be a real set. Let $T$ be a subset of $S$. Let $S$ and $T$ admit infima. Then: $\inf S = \inf T \iff \forall \epsilon \in \R_{>0}: \forall s \in S: \exists t \in T: s + \epsilon > t$

label: Condition for Injective Mapping on Ordinals
snippet: Let $F$ be a mapping satisfying the following properties: $(1): \quad$ The domain of $F$ is $\On$, the class of all ordinals $(2): \quad$ For all ordinals $x$, $\map F x = \map G {F \restriction x}$ $(3): \quad$ For all ordinals $x$, $\map G {F \restriction x} \in \paren {A \setminus \Img x}$ where $\Img x$ is the image of $x$ under $F$. Let $\Img F$ denote the image of $F$. Then the following properties hold: $(1): \quad \Img F \subseteq A$ $(2): \quad F$ is injective $(3): \quad A$ is a proper class. Note that only the third property of $F$ is the most important.

label: Condition for Invertibility in Power Structure on Associative or Cancellable Operation
snippet: Let $\struct {S, \circ}$ be a unital magma. Let $\struct {\powerset S, \circ_\PP}$ denote the power structure of $\struct {S, \circ}$. Let identity element $e \in S$ be an identity element of $\struct {S, \circ}$. Let $\circ$ be either: an associative operation a cancellable operation. Let $X \subseteq S$ be a subset of $S$. Then: $X$ is invertible for $\circ_PP$ there exists an element $x \in S$ which is invertible for $\circ$ such that $X = \set x$.

label: Condition for Isomorphism between Structures Induced by Permutations
snippet: Let $S$ be a set. Let $\oplus$ and $\otimes$ be closed operations on $S$ such that both $\oplus$ and $\otimes$ have the same identity. Let $\sigma$ and $\tau$ be permutations on $S$. Let $\oplus_\sigma$ and $\otimes_\tau$ be the operations on $S$ induced on $\oplus$ by $\sigma$ and on $\otimes$ by $\tau$ respectively: $\forall x, y \in S: x \oplus_\sigma y := \map \sigma {x \oplus y}$ $\forall x, y \in S: x \otimes_\tau y := \map \tau {x \otimes y}$ Let $f: S \to S$ be a mapping.

label: Condition for Limits of Computable Real Sequences to be Computable
snippet: Let $\sequence {x_k}_{k \in \N}$ be a computable real sequence. Let $\sequence {y_n}_{n \in \N}$ be a real sequence. If there exists total recursive function $\phi : \N^2 \to \N$ such that: $\forall n, p \in \N: \size {x_{\map \phi {n, p}} - y_n} < \dfrac 1 {p + 1}$ then: $\sequence {y_n}_{n \in \N}$ is a computable real sequence.

label: Condition for Linear Dependence of Linear Functionals in terms of Kernel
snippet: Let $V$ be a vector space over a field $\GF$. Let $f, f_1, \ldots, f_n: V \to \GF$ be linear functionals. Suppose that: $\ds \bigcap_{i \mathop = 1}^n \ker f_i \subseteq \ker f$ where $\ker f$ denotes the kernel of $f$. Then there exist $\alpha_1, \ldots, \alpha_n \in \GF$ such that: $\ds \forall v \in V: \map f v = \sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n \alpha_i \map {f_i} v$ That is: $f \in \span \set {f_1, \ldots, f_n}$

label: Condition for Linear Divisor of Polynomial
snippet: Let $\map P x$ be a polynomial in $x$. Let $a$ be a constant. Then $x - a$ is a divisor of $\map P x$ $a$ is a root of $P$.

label: Condition for Linear Operation on Complex Numbers to be of Finite Order
snippet: Let $A$ be the operation on the complex numbers $\C$ defined as: $\map A x = \alpha x + \beta$ Then $A$ is of finite order greater than $1$ $\alpha$ is a root of unity other than $1$.

label: Condition for Lines to be Conjugate
snippet: Let $\CC$ be a circle of radius $r$ whose center is at the origin of a Cartesian plane. Let $\PP$ and $\QQ$ be conjugate lines with respect to $\CC$: Then: $l_1 l_2 + m_1 m_2 = \dfrac {n_1 n_2} {r^2}$

label: Condition for Mapping between Structures to be Homomorphism
snippet: Let $\struct {A, \odot}$ and $\struct {B, \circledast}$ be magmas. Let $\struct {A \times B, \otimes}$ be the external direct product of $\struct {A, \odot}$ and $\struct {B, \circledast}$. Let $\phi: A \to B$ be a mapping. Let $\phi$ be considered as a subset of the Cartesian product $A \times B$. Then: $\phi$ is a homomorphism the algebraic structure $\struct {\phi, \otimes_\phi}$ is a submagma of $\struct {A \times B, \otimes}$.

label: Condition for Mapping from Quotient Set to be Injection
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR$ be an equivalence relation on $S$. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping from $S$ to $T$. Let $S / \RR$ be the quotient set of $S$ induced by $\RR$. Let $q_\RR: S \to S / \RR$ be the quotient mapping induced by $\RR$. Let the mapping $\phi: S / \RR \to T$ defined as: $\phi \circ q_\RR = f$ be well-defined. Then: $\phi$ is an injection $\forall x, y \in S: \tuple {x, y} \in \RR \iff \map f x = \map f y$

label: Condition for Mapping from Quotient Set to be Surjection
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR$ be an equivalence relation on $S$. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping from $S$ to $T$. Let $S / \RR$ be the quotient set of $S$ induced by $\RR$. Let $q_\RR: S \to S / \RR$ be the quotient mapping induced by $\RR$. Let the mapping $\phi: S / \RR \to T$ defined as: $\phi \circ q_\RR = f$ be well-defined. Then: $\phi$ is a surjection $f$ is a surjection.

label: Condition for Mapping from Quotient Set to be Well-Defined
snippet: Let $S$ and $T$ be sets. Let $\RR$ be an equivalence relation on $S$. Let $f: S \to T$ be a mapping from $S$ to $T$. Let $S / \RR$ be the quotient set of $S$ induced by $\RR$. Let $q_\RR: S \to S / \RR$ be the quotient mapping induced by $\RR$. Then: there exists a mapping $\phi: S / \RR \to T$ such that $\phi \circ q_\RR = f$ $\forall x, y \in S: \tuple {x, y} \in \RR \implies \map f x = \map f y$ $\begin {xy} \xymatrix@L + 2mu@ + 1em { S \ar[r]^*{f} \ar[d]_*{q_\RR} & T \\ S / \RR \ar@{-->}[ur]_*{\phi} } \end {xy}$

label: Condition for Mapping from Quotient Vector Space to be Well-Defined
snippet: Let $V, W$ be vector spaces. Let $T: V \to W$ be a linear transformation. Let $M$ be a subspace of $V$. Let $V / M$ be the quotient vector space of $V$ by $M$. Let $Q_M: V \to V / M$ be the associated quotient mapping. Then: there exists a linear transformation $L: V / M \to W$ such that $L \circ Q_M = T$ $M \subseteq \ker T$ $\begin {xy} \xymatrix@L + 2mu@ + 1em {V \ar[r]^*{T} \ar[d]_*{Q_M} & W \\ V / M \ar@{-->}[ur]_*{L} } \end {xy}$

label: Condition for Membership is Right Compatible with Ordinal Exponentiation
snippet: Let $x, y, z$ be ordinals. Let $z$ be the successor of some ordinal $w$. Then: $x < y \iff x^z < y^z$

label: Condition for Membership of Equivalence Class
snippet: Let $\RR$ be an equivalence relation on a set $S$. Let $\eqclass x \RR$ denote the $\RR$-equivalence class of $x$. Then: $\forall y \in S: y \in \eqclass x \RR \iff \tuple {x, y} \in \RR$

label: Condition for Method of Least Squares to match Maximum Likelihood Estimation
snippet: Let $X_n$ and $Y_n$ be sets of $n$ paired observations of random variables $X$ and $Y$. For the paired observations $\tuple {x_i, y_i}$: let $x_i$ be error-free let the errors in $y_i$ be identical and normally distributed with expectation $0$. Then the method of least squares yields a result equivalent to the maximum likelihood estimator.
